extracted.name: Roasted Balsamic Cauliflower
extracted.description: This roasted balsamic cauliflower recipe features florets coated in vinegar, olive oil, salt, and chopped garlic and baked in the oven at high heat.
ingredient_lines: 1 head cauliflower, chopped into bite size pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Stir together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and garlic in a bowl. Add cauliflower and toss to coat. Spread mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
